sources.prompt: Create an original updated 16:9 gameplay HUD concept in the approved lunar-porcelain style: pearl ceramic, plum enamel, slim silver crescent/petal edges, tiny turquoise insets. Preserve the actual grassy isometric world and hero. Small resources upper left; compact «День 1 / 08:30» upper right. Bottom-left local minimap remains. CRITICAL: the bottom console begins immediately RIGHT of the minimap and extends ALL THE WAY TO THE RIGHT SCREEN EDGE, with no empty strip beyond it. Keep its height compact ~125 px in 1600×900. Five compact access buttons I Вещи / B Стройка / P Исследования / O Герой / M Карта sit directly ABOVE this console. Inside fullwidth console: LEFT about 24% contains a small hero C portrait, separate small bow icon, «Лук», and compact VERTICAL equipment stats «Урон 2», «Радиус 5,5», «Интервал 1,1 с». CENTER about 46% contains a tidy row of original empty plum-and-pearl ability/action slots, clearly unassigned, no spells or item icons. RIGHT about 30% contains THREE elegant slender horizontal tracks: red «Здоровье —», blue «Мана —», orange «Опыт —». These are explicitly future UI reserves: no numeric amounts, no level, no percentages, no fully filled bars. Use subdued tinted tracks with dashes so unavailable is clear. Rich beautiful curved fantasy materials, NOT black rectangles; typography clean and readable. Small external caption «Эскиз HUD · умения и шкалы пока не подключены». Do not invent gameplay systems or change world art.

Same 16:9 gameplay frame, world, small upper resource/day-time widgets, bottom-left local minimap and five menu buttons. Match the approved lunar-porcelain fantasy style: pearl ceramic, plum enamel, slim silver crescent/petal edges, tiny turquoise insets. Show B Стройка selected. The ENTIRE fullwidth lower console to the RIGHT of the minimap is now REPLACED by a NONMODAL BUILDING RIBBON reaching the RIGHT SCREEN EDGE; no big central window, no hero portrait, no weapon stats, no ability slots or HP/mana/XP tracks in this mode. Keep battlefield clear. Upper band inside ribbon: category tabs «Оборона», «Производство», «База»; Оборона selected. Beneath: three compact illustrated cards «Rapid», «Longshot», «Частокол», with original project-style watchtower/catapult/wooden barrier thumbnails. Exact prices with resource icons: Rapid gold5 wood2 stone1; Longshot wood2 stone5; Частокол wood1. Card content readable and comfortably spaced. To the RIGHT use remaining ribbon width for selected Rapid detail: small thumbnail, title, repeated price and compact action «Выбрать», then tiny placement hints «ЛКМ · поставить» / «Esc · отменить». No dead empty right panel. Pearl/plum/silver/turquoise lunar-porcelain artistry, curved edges, subtle carved details, no black-card UI, no invented prices, timers or tower stats. This is a visual proposal only. Caption «Эскиз · строительство на нижней панели».

Original production-ready UI component atlas, 2048×2048 transparent RGBA, orthographic front view, NO game screenshot, NO text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO icons or portraits. Match approved C rich pearl ceramic, muted plum enamel, silver crescent/petal silhouettes and restrained turquoise gems. Arrange 2 columns × 3 rows with large transparent separation and NO overlaps. TOP LEFT: elegant large rectangular window frame with curved sculpted corners and a calm EMPTY PALE PEARL CENTER, suitable for nine-slice stretching; ornate detail concentrated at corners, long edges simple. TOP RIGHT: matching thin small inset content-panel frame with pale pearl center, simple stretchable edges. MIDDLE LEFT: compact horizontal plum-enamel button with curved pearl/silver perimeter, blank center. MIDDLE RIGHT: same button SELECTED with turquoise accent, blank center. BOTTOM LEFT: round local-map bezel with FULLY TRANSPARENT INNER CIRCLE, pearl/plum/silver rim, no symbols. BOTTOM RIGHT: empty round portrait/equipment medallion with FULLY TRANSPARENT INNER CIRCLE. Flat forward-facing UI art, crisp alpha, no cast shadow outside shapes, no filled background, no checkerboard drawn into image, no labels. All six pieces isolated; margins at least 40px. Preserve refined fantasy form rather than simple rectangles.

sources.prompt: Original transparent RGBA UI ICON ATLAS 2048×1024, front-facing painterly fantasy icons in approved lunar-porcelain visual language. Exactly TWO ROWS × SIX COLUMNS, each icon isolated centered in its own equally sized invisible cell, at least20% transparent padding, no text/numbers/borders/cell lines, NO tile background. TOP ROW left-to-right: gold coin stack; wood logs; pale stone pieces; silver iron ingot; leather inventory pouch; construction hammer. BOTTOM ROW left-to-right: open research book; neutral universal hero silhouette medallion; folded map; curved wooden starter bow; small sun; simple close X made of silver. Strong legible silhouettes, refined warm materials and subtle pearl/plum/turquoise accents, no excessive glow, no extra objects, no repeated icons. These are production UI icons, transparent outside each object; not a concept sheet over scenery. Do not add any abilities, potions or spells.
